raw.query: WITH cat AS (SELECT source_path, n_images, total_kernel_ms, SUM(ms) AS cat_sum FROM provenance.collector_kernel_ledger WHERE entry_kind='category' GROUP BY source_path, n_images, total_kernel_ms) SELECT source_path, n_images, total_kernel_ms, cat_sum, total_kernel_ms - cat_sum AS remainder_ms FROM cat ORDER BY n_images
raw.observed: N=1 remainder=1.78e-15 ms; N=64 remainder=-0.001 ms (category sum equals total_kernel_ms to floating-point precision)
raw.evidence: collector_kernel_ledger category entries sum to total_kernel_ms within 1e-3 ms for both N=1 and N=64; no 0.7 ms residual exists in any fold
raw.fix: Replace '≈0.7 ms remainder' with 'no measurable remainder — category sums match total_kernel_ms to floating-point precision (≤0.001 ms across N=1 and N=64)'
